prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:

1: ["Keep Your Companion Safe", "Signing in ensures your pet data, custom looks, and memories are backed up permanently to your account.", "Cloud Save Active", "Proceed to Sign In"]
2: []
3: ["Meet Your New Companion", "Review your pet's attributes and official adoption certificate details.", "Pet Live Preview", "Official Companion Pass"]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Verifying screen overlay drivers and graphics settings for optimal pet behavior.", "Screen Overlay Driver: Ready | Graphics Engine: Active"]
5: ["Master Desktop Controls in Seconds", "Try hiding, calling, and interacting with your pet right now using the quick access panel.", "Test Summon Pet", "Right-click pet for instant menu options | Press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P to call pet"]
6: ["Choose Your Companion Avatar", "Swipe through available desktop buddies to find your perfect match.", "Featured Pet Avatar"]
7: ["Desktop Display Check", "Checking multi-monitor support and system tray integration.", "System Integration Check", "Launch Pet to Desktop"]
8: ["Select Your Companion Journey", "Pick the path that best matches how you work and play on your desktop.", "Most Popular Choice"]
9: ["Pro tip: Double-click your pet to open settings, or drag anywhere to relocate on screen."]
